name: updateLocationsAdvanced
description: Changes several locations at once, up to 50.

locations.description: The changes to make, one per location, up to 50 at a time.

locationId.description: The location's id, as shown in search results.

newTitle.description: The location's new title. Leave it out to keep the current one.

subtitle.description: A short line shown under the title. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

address.description: The location's address. Leave it out to keep the current one.

latitude.description: Where the location is, north to south. Leave it out to keep the current one.

longitude.description: Where the location is, east to west. Leave it out to keep the current one.

addressAlias.description: A name shown on the map instead of the address. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

description.description: What the location screen says about it, as formatted text. Leave it out to keep the current one.

listImage.description: The picture shown for the location in lists, as a list holding one picture. Leave it out to keep the current one.

images.description: The location's pictures, in order. Replaces the current pictures; leave it out to keep them.

categories.description: The categories it is in, by name, with a subcategory after an arrow, such as "Parks -> Gardens, Museums". Replaces the current ones; leave it out to keep them, or leave it empty to remove them all.

markerType.description: How the location is marked on the map. Leave it out to keep the current one.

markerImage.description: The picture used as an image marker, as a list holding one picture. Leave it out to keep it, or pass an empty list to remove it.

markerColor.description: The color of a circle marker, such as "rgba(253,35,5,1)". Leave it out to keep it, or leave it empty to remove it.

showCategory.description: Whether the location screen shows its categories. Leave it out to keep the current one.

showOpeningHours.description: Whether the location screen shows its opening hours. Leave it out to keep the current one.

showPriceRange.description: Whether the location screen shows its price range. Leave it out to keep the current one.

showStarRating.description: Whether people can rate the location with stars. Leave it out to keep the current one.

priceRange.description: How expensive the location is. Leave it out to keep the current one.

priceCurrency.description: The currency sign of the price range. Leave it out to keep the current one.

actionItems.description: Buttons on the location screen, such as calling a number or opening a website. Replaces the current ones; leave it out to keep them.

pinned.description: Whether the location is pinned to the top of the list; up to 3 can be. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

mondayHours.description: When it is open on Monday, such as "08:00-20:00" or "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it.

tuesdayHours.description: When it is open on Tuesday, such as "08:00-20:00" or "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it.

wednesdayHours.description: When it is open on Wednesday, such as "08:00-20:00" or "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it.

thursdayHours.description: When it is open on Thursday, such as "08:00-20:00" or "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it.

fridayHours.description: When it is open on Friday, such as "08:00-20:00" or "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it.

saturdayHours.description: When it is open on Saturday, such as "08:00-20:00" or "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it.

sundayHours.description: When it is open on Sunday, such as "08:00-20:00" or "08:00-12:00, 13:00-20:00", or "closed". Leave it out to keep it.

callback.description: Runs when all the locations are done.

error.description: Why nothing was changed, such as a location id no one has.

locations.description: One result per location, in the order they were given.

index.description: Which location this is, counting from 0.

id.description: The location's id, if it was changed.

error.description: Why it wasn't changed, if it wasn't.
